# Pip v4: build guide (generated by `python -m rnd.build_guide`)

**First build:** about **24 h hands-on** (ESTIMATE), plus about **352 h of unattended P2S printing** (14.8 kg PETG/ASA). Reconfiguring later: an arm cartridge swap is 4 ear screws (M4 + nuts) with the belt on (~3 min); an arm comes off with one V-band clamp.
**One arm** (the first milestone build): about **6.1 h** hands-on (6.13 → 6.13 h, +0 min, since the last guide), plus ≈ 78 h of printing.

Parts: [BOM](rnd/BOM_v4.md) · M1 kit: [M1_BENCH_ARM.md](M1_BENCH_ARM.md) · prints: [print plan](rnd/print_plan.md) · wiring: [electrical](rnd/electrical.md) · checks: [assembly](rnd/assembly.md), [sim](rnd/sim.md)

| Step | What | Count | Min each | Hours |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| | **Total hands-on** | | | **24.2** |

**Wave 1 (D24 bolted cartridges, D19):** sockets + cartridges 3.8 → 2.6 h for the robot; one arm 6.05 → 6.13 h (+5 min). The 5 D15 sockets per arm go (−40 min); the bolted cartridges' inserts and Oldham hub take about half of that back. D19's one-piece shaft-pulleys replace the split pulleys (no keyed joint to fit) at about the same time, the seat-cap screws included.

**Against R10** (first build ≤ 4 h): **not met.**
- **Loop 10 cut the estimate from 25 h to ~19 h:**
    - print-in-place KX sockets with pins and spring embedded at print pauses (no retainer, no screws) — *retired in loop 40 (D15): the screwed socket takes ≈ 8 min; D24 then removed the sockets from the arm*
    - 7 instead of 14 screws per cartridge
    - eccentric-bushing belt tensioning
    - pre-made harness segments
- **A 21-actuator robot won't reach 4 h.** Precedent: a 6-servo LeRobot SO-101 arm takes a few hours.
- **Proposed target split (owner decision):** first build of one arm ≤ 4 h; whole robot ≤ 15 h; any module swap ≤ 5 min.

## Safety notes
- 24 V Li-ion: use the specified BMS (≥ 30 A), fuse every branch, and charge on a non-flammable surface.
- The arms can pinch. Torque limits are set in the drives (bring-up step 2, saved to flash) and bounded again by the safety supervisor. The bolted arm cartridges have **no mechanical slip backstop** (the KX seats slipped at ≈ 1.16× peak); only the head sockets still do.
- Test the lift pawl, the e-stop and the watchdog (sw/bringup.py step 3) before any powered arm motion; bench work with the catch cradle ≤ 50 mm under the arm.
